checks.name: Outline (next to Export) opens beside the note: Gear, Tent nested under it, Food; title on top; word count and reading time below
choosing Food scrolls the note so Food is near the top, highlights it and marks it current; the caret stays put
scrolling back to the top marks the title as current
a heading typed into the note appears in the outline within the debounce, and the note saves it
a heading added by an edit from outside the editor (agent path) appears in the outline
Meta+Shift+O closes and opens the outline without taking focus from the note; open stays open after a reload
narrow work area: the outline lies over the note (the note keeps its width) and steps aside after choosing Tent, which is then near the top
edge: a note without headings says "No headings yet" with its own count (30 words · 1 min read); switching tabs shows each note its own outline
edge: a heading that looks like HTML shows as text, with no element made and nothing run
edge: 300 headings: the outline opens in 25 ms, 20 typed characters take 344 ms (longest task 102 ms), and the list follows the note to Section 300
edge: switching profiles with the panel open shows no outline in the other profile; back again, the note's tab shows its own outline

limits: One Mac, from source under Electron on the carried runtime. The agent edit is applied through the same ops call and announced the way a finished agent edit is (controller.refresh), not by a provider run.
